contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A contempary copy of copper-alloy Roman radiate of Gallienus (AD 253-268) , solo reign, dating to AD 260-268 . Reverse type depicting Salus feeding a snake rising from an alter, with sceptre. Reverse inscription reads [*]ALV. Weight 2.83g Diameter 20.48mm Thickness 2.02mm. Condition: Fair
